run_finetune_centroids: run student/teacher distillation training loop with KL divergence loss on a PyTorch train loader
run_evaluate: run standard evaluation loop on a test loader and return top-1 accuracy for a PyTorch model
create_AverageMeter: create an AverageMeter instance to track running average and current values for training metrics
create_ProgressMeter: create a ProgressMeter to print formatted batch progress with multiple AverageMeter metrics
run_accuracy: run top-k accuracy computation on model output logits and ground truth target tensors
